extensions.name: pgvector
extensions.description: Required for storing and querying vector embeddings of stanzas

album.description: Represents Drake's albums cataloged from Spotify API

id.description: Unique Spotify ID for the album

images_url.description: URL of the album artwork image

total_tracks.description: Total number of tracks on the album

track.description: Represents Drake's songs cataloged from Spotify API & Musixmatch API

id.description: Unique Spotify ID for the track

album_id.description: Foreign key referencing the album table (album.id)

disc_number.description: Disc number of the track (usually 1 unless a multi-disc release)

lyrics.description: Full lyrics text of the track

external_urls.description: JSON object containing external URLs (e.g., Spotify links)

audio_feature.description: Represents audio feature for a drake song

song_id.description: Foreign key referencing the track table (track.id)

acousticness.description: A confidence measure from 0.0 to 1.0 of whether the track is acoustic

danceability.description: Danceability describes how suitable a track is for dancing based on musical elements

energy.description: A measure from 0.0 to 1.0 representing a perceptual measure of intensity and activity

instrumentalness.description: Predicts whether a track contains no vocals (0.0 to 1.0)

key.description: The key the track is in using standard Pitch Class notation (e.g., 0 = C, 1 = C#, 2 = D)

liveness.description: Detects the presence of an audience in the recording (0.0 to 1.0)

loudness.description: The overall loudness of a track in decibels (dB)

mode.description: Modality of a track (1 = major, 0 = minor)

speechiness.description: Speechiness detects the presence of spoken words in a track

tempo.description: The overall estimated tempo of a track in beats per minute (BPM)

time_signature.description: An estimated time signature, specifying how many beats are in each bar

valence.description: A measure from 0.0 to 1.0 describing the musical positiveness conveyed by a track

stanza.description: Stores individual lyric chunks optimized for Vector Search and RAG. Will be based of the lyric column in song_id

id.description: Unique auto-incrementing primary key for the stanza

song_id.description: Foreign key referencing the track table (track.id)

lyric_chunk.description: Text content of the lyric stanza/chunk

chunk_index.description: Sequential index of the stanza within the track's lyrics

embedding.description: Dense vector embedding representing the lyric chunk for semantic search

personal_feel.description: Subjective categorization classification for the stanza (e.g., 'Late Night Drive', 'Hype', 'Introspective')
